text:
Olivia (Growth): Quick check — I'm sketching 3 snackable cards for the benchmark launch: 1) latency vs cost microchart, 2) throughput economics heatmap, 3) tail-latency vignette. Goal: social+web+webinar hooks. Thoughts?
Sam (Product Marketing): Love the 3-card approach. For the latency vs cost card can we show 'tokens/sec' on one axis and 'cost per 1k tokens' on the other? simple x/y
Jess (Creative): I can mock two visual directions: clean line chart vs stacked area. Which is more friendly for non-technical eyeballs?
Nate (Analytics): Line chart is clearer for trend. Also add a very small caption: "Measured on typical chat traffic, mixed prompt lengths" — keeps expectations.
Meera (Growth Ops): Landing page needs a routing param so webinar signups go to product demo flow vs sales ops. Suggest utm=bench_launch and ?route=webinar or ?route=sales
Alex (Sales Lead): If route=sales, auto-assign to AE queue if ARR > $50k. Can Growth Ops tag leads with "bench_high_value" flag?
Meera (Growth Ops): Yep, can pass leadScore >= 80 to CRM and set bench_high_value. Need the demo form to include avg tokens/day field to help qualify.
Olivia (Growth): Good call. Add a short one-liner on the card: "Same API, 3x lower token cost at median latency" — is that too marketing-y?
Sam (Product Marketing): Risk of overclaim. Maybe: "Up to 3x lower unit cost for common chat workloads" — accurate and safe.
Jess (Creative): I'll create two variants: V1 with that phrasing, V2 softer: "Meaningfully lower unit costs for chat applications". Will share comps by EOD.
Nate (Analytics): Also need baseline model and test harness callout in small text: model x.y + 2048 context + mix of 10/30/100 token prompts. We'll provide the CSV.
Olivia (Growth): Can we script an animated GIF showing latency drop when prefix cache kicks in? Small loop, 3s.
Jess (Creative): Yep. I'll need sequence frames and a short caption. Nate — can you export the trace data by 3pm?
Nate (Analytics): On it. Will drop a link to the CSV in this thread when ready.
Meera (Growth Ops): For routing — I'll create two landing flows: webinar (nurture sequence) and demo (AE). Alex — who on sales should own demo follow-ups?
Alex (Sales Lead): Assign to Priya and Mark. I'll send a quick onboarding doc.
marketing-bot: Reminder: webinar date T-14 days. Add promotional cadence: email, organic, paid social.
Olivia (Growth): Thanks all. Action items: Jess mockups, Nate CSV+gif data, Meera landing + routing params, Sam final copy. Let's reconvene tomorrow 10am if assets are in place.
Sam (Product Marketing): Confirmed. I'll tighten claims and draft the webinar CTAs.
Jess (Creative): I'll post comps and an animated GIF draft in #design-review channel shortly.
Nate (Analytics): CSV link: https://internal.s3/redwood/benchshots/latency_cost_trace_v1.csv
Meera (Growth Ops): I'll add the CRM mapping doc to Confluence and share the link after setup.
Olivia (Growth): Perfect. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :rocket:
